revisions.summary: From your words: the ride is asked markedly faster throughout, most of all in the suspension. The landings and their strengths are as before.

points.text: The suspension: the largest gain in speed.

revisions.summary: From your notes. All seven of your earlier marks in the pickup at 4.6–5.5 s now have a landing (two were missing). The suspension at 21–26.6 s is asked much lower, as very light touches. Speed is raised here too.

points.text: Seven landings on your earlier marks, then the drum.
